backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor defining all types (user profiles, rituals, challenges, love languages, pairing, stats) and including mixins for blob storage and authorization with access control state initialization.
feature_evidence.json: Empty feature evidence report JSON with no features listed.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend files including components, pages, hooks, and configuration, documenting the romantic theme, authentication flow, daily rituals, love languages quiz, insights, activities, and navigation.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light and dark themes using OKLCH color space, defining colors for background, foreground, card, primary, secondary, muted, accent, destructive, border, input, ring, charts, and sidebar.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with favicon links, viewport meta tags, theme color, SEO metadata, and pre-React theme initialization script that applies 'dark' class based on localStorage or system preference to prevent flash of unstyled content.
frontend/QA_ACCEPTANCE_CHECKLIST.md: QA checklist for Version 66 reset verification covering draft build label display, build stability, feature verification, and historical checklists for versions 76, 64, 63, and 62.
frontend/QA_VERSION_66_RESET_REPORT.md: Detailed verification report confirming successful Version 66 reset with passing status for draft build labels, build stability, core functionality (landing, login, profile, rituals, quiz, tabs, theme), and absence of post-v66 features.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main application component that manages authentication state, routing between tabs (home, insights, memories, activities, us), and handles profile setup flow with loading/error states.
frontend/src/components/BottomNav.tsx: Fixed bottom navigation bar component with 5 tabs (Home, Insights, Memories, Activities, Us), each with icons and active state styling.
frontend/src/components/CompletionAnimat: Renders floating heart animations with randomized positions and delays, used for completion celebrations.
frontend/src/components/CoupleLevelXPMod: Displays couple level, XP progress bar, and level label based on insights data using couple level calculation utilities.
frontend/src/components/DataStates.tsx: Provides reusable UI components for loading, empty, error, and section header states with consistent styling and optional retry actions.
frontend/src/components/HarmonyBreakdown: Card component showing current harmony percentage, 7-day trend sparkline, and breakdown of quiz overlap and completion rate with expandable explanations.
Compact button displaying harmony score and trend indicator that navigates to the insights page when clicked.
frontend/src/components/LandingBrand.tsx: Displays GrowInLove logo and brand name in default or compact variants with fallback to text-only if image fails to load.
frontend/src/components/LandingFooterLin: Dialog component that displays footer content (About, Contact, Terms, Privacy, Investor) in a modal with scrollable text sections. Uses a switch statement to render different content based on the selected footer link.
frontend/src/components/LandingHeroScree: Displays a phone mockup with a carousel of landing page screenshots. Features a notch design, dot indicators for navigation, and allows users to switch between screenshots by clicking dots.
Expandable founder story component that shows a preview of 3 paragraphs with a "Read more/less" toggle button. Splits the founder story content by double newlines and displays it as prose.
frontend/src/components/LandingScreensho: Full-featured carousel component with phone mockup, previous/next navigation buttons, auto-advance every 5 seconds, and dot indicators. Displays landing screenshots with captions below the phone frame.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Authentication button component that handles Internet Identity login/logout with loading states. Clears the query cache on logout and includes error handling for already-authenticated users.
frontend/src/components/LoveChallenges.t: Weekly challenge card component with photo upload capability for proof of completion. Features loading/error states, completion animation, photo preview, and handles challenge completion with optional photo blob upload.
frontend/src/components/OurLoveLanguages: Interactive card component for love languages feature with primary action button and insights shortcut link. Supports optional highlight animation, loading states, and click-through functionality.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetup.tsx: Onboarding form component that collects user's name to initialize their profile. Shows success animation with checkmark before calling onSuccess callback, includes error handling and validation.
frontend/src/components/RewardVisuals.ts: Displays reward progress visualizations including streak boost indicators, heart-shaped progress meters, and milestone badges based on challenge completion data from insights API.
frontend/src/components/SpinWheel.tsx: Interactive spinning wheel component that randomly selects a love language for daily activities, with localStorage-based daily spin limits and smooth easing animations.
frontend/src/components/StreakMilestoneB: Displays streak milestone badges (3, 7, 14, 30, 60, 100 days) with unlock status and current streak progress visualization.
frontend/src/components/ThemeToggle.tsx: Simple button component that toggles between light and dark themes using the theme context hook.
frontend/src/components/UnlockPacks.tsx: Displays love language activity packs that unlock progressively based on streak milestones, each containing themed relationship-building activities.
frontend/src/config/draftBuildLabel.ts: Configuration file that returns the current draft build version label for preview identification.
frontend/src/content/contact.ts: Exports the contact email address constant for the application.
frontend/src/content/founderStory.ts: Contains the founder's narrative about how GrowInLove was created during a four-day app competition to strengthen their own relationship.
Defines the landing page screenshot configuration array with image paths and captions for hero and carousel displays.
frontend/src/contexts/ThemeContext.tsx: React context provider for theme management supporting light, dark, and system preferences with localStorage persistence and system media query watching.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook that manages the backend actor instance using React Query, creating authenticated or anonymous actors based on Internet Identity state and invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context and hooks for login/logout functionality, managing identity state with AuthClient and delegation validation.
frontend/src/hooks/usePrefersReducedMoti: React hook that detects and tracks the user's prefers-reduced-motion media query preference for accessibility.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Centralized collection of React Query hooks for all backend API calls including user profiles, rituals, quizzes, challenges, insights, and admin functions using the actor from useActor.
frontend/src/hooks/useSectionEntrance.ts: React hook using IntersectionObserver to detect when elements enter the viewport for entrance animations, respecting reduced motion preferences.
frontend/src/hooks/useTheme.ts: Re-exports the useTheme hook from ThemeContext for backward compatibility.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom romantic-themed color variables using OKLCH color space for light and dark modes, plus utility classes and animations.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query and Internet Identity providers, then renders the App component.
frontend/src/pages/Activities.tsx: Activities page displaying love challenges, couple XP, streak badges, rewards, and spin wheel features, requiring authentication and pairing (or admin override) to access.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Main home page displaying daily rituals with prompts, text/photo responses, completion animations, and a scrollable history of past ritual entries. Includes love language mapping, date formatting utilities, and modal dialogs for viewing full entry details.
frontend/src/pages/Insights.tsx: Insights dashboard showing relationship metrics including current/longest streaks, average harmony score, harmony trend breakdown, love language compatibility, and milestone badges. Fetches backend-driven analytics data and displays celebration animations for newly unlocked achievements.
frontend/src/pages/Landing.tsx: Public landing page with hero section, feature highlights, screenshot carousel, privacy section, FAQ collapsibles, and call-to-action buttons. Includes navigation to login and various informational dialogs (about, contact, terms, privacy).
frontend/src/pages/LoveLanguages.tsx: Love languages quiz interface with multi-step questions, progress tracking, result calculation/display, and ability to save/clear results. Maps between UI language names and backend enum values, and shows combined quiz state for both partners.
frontend/src/pages/Memories.tsx: Archive view of past ritual entries with expandable cards showing prompts, responses, and photos. Displays formatted dates, love language focus, and allows users to browse their relationship history.
frontend/src/pages/Us.tsx: React component for the 'Us' page that handles partner pairing via codes, displays user/partner profiles, shows love languages, quiz results, and couple level/XP progress with celebration animations.
frontend/src/utils/coupleLevel.ts: Frontend utility that calculates couple level and XP from insights data (streak, challenges, harmony) using a progressive leveling formula, and provides level labels like 'Legendary Couple' or 'New Journey'.
frontend/src/utils/harmony.ts: Utility functions for harmony score display: converts harmony to percentage, normalizes 7-day trend series, and determines trend direction (up/down/stable) with corresponding icons and colors.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: URL parameter parsing utilities that work with hash-based routing, supporting extraction from query strings or hash fragments, with sessionStorage persistence and cleanup functions.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom color schemes (romantic, peach, cream), typography with Nunito/Quicksand fonts, animations (accordion, fade-in-up), and container settings.
project_state.json: Project state tracking file listing pending feature requests to persist XP values and badges in backend storage, and remove 'draft version 66' text from the app header.
